name: Miffy bounded frontal pitch v34 · non-production

headPitch.faceOwner: face layer with eye overlays, combined in the existing yaw sampler
headPitch.driver: manual pitch slider; +100 up and -100 down
headPitch.note: A small visible pitch trial using the existing frontal texture. The face uses the same depth hypothesis as yaw; eye overlays are composited before sampling. Hair and neck use smaller owner-layer vertical fields with fixed lower boundaries. No unseen scalp, under-chin or nostril artwork is invented.

limits: Pending task-scoped 2.5D pitch test, not Live2D's editor deformers or a true 3D head. No production or portfolio promotion.
Review pitch at both signs, middle values and combined yaw/pitch corners. The +5/-5 degree endpoints are provisional visual limits, not approved animation defaults.
Inspect frontal baked brow/nose/mouth, blink/gaze, hairline, ear, jaw/neck seams, and speed. Return to v33 if the frontal art cannot support the intended angle.
